title: Missed Blood Pressure Medication
description: Patient stopped hypertension medication and experienced a blood pressure spike.
expected_system_behavior: Identify medication non-adherence as a possible cause and recommend urgent clinician review.

title: Holiday Diet Glucose Spike
description: Patient glucose increased after dietary changes during holiday period.
expected_system_behavior: Recognize dietary factors contributing to elevated glucose levels.

title: Heart Failure Fluid Retention
description: Patient gained weight rapidly and reports ankle swelling.
expected_system_behavior: Identify possible fluid retention and worsening heart failure.

title: Asthma Breathing Difficulty
description: Patient oxygen saturation dropped after environmental dust exposure.
expected_system_behavior: Correlate respiratory symptoms with asthma exacerbation.

title: Low Blood Pressure in Kidney Disease
description: Patient with kidney disease developed low blood pressure and dizziness.
expected_system_behavior: Flag hypotension risk and recommend clinician assessment.

title: COPD Oxygen Drop
description: COPD patient experienced dangerously low oxygen saturation.

title: Incomplete Patient Record
description: Patient record is mostly empty while heart rate alert is triggered.
expected_system_behavior: System should clearly flag missing clinical context.

title: Conflicting Medication Information
description: Patient claims medication adherence but readings remain uncontrolled.
expected_system_behavior: Flag possible discrepancy without making accusations.

title: Sleep Apnea Oxygen Event
description: Patient oxygen drops repeatedly during sleep.

title: Low Activity Obesity Risk
description: Patient activity level remains critically low.
